originating_goal: Distinguish locally inferred shutdown failure and independent convergence from unsupported cross-service conferral or moral-state claims.
release_condition: A canonical run for a commit containing the complete package passes validation and build, deploys Pages, and verifies the peer-preservation doctrine and status routes; otherwise remain fail-closed and retry on the next canonical trigger.
collision_boundary: No second workflow or session may independently mutate the same activation state while this machine-owned task is active.
next_task_after_release: Queue bounded downstream awareness only after each destination mirror handoff grants mutation authority.
